name: Pinacoteca di Brera
tagline: Milan's great picture gallery, built from Napoleonic-era confiscations of church and convent art.

artworks.title: The Kiss
artworks.description: A cloaked couple embrace on a stairway in this defining image of Italian Romanticism, widely read as an allegory for the Risorgimento's political alliances.

artworks.title: The Marriage of the Virgin
artworks.description: A young Raphael's breakthrough altarpiece, its perfectly symmetrical temple and calm perspective marking his arrival as heir to Perugino's generation.
